judge_prompt: You are checking a stock image for a short educational video. Scene narration: "{narration}". Requested picture: "{query}". Decide whether this image genuinely shows the requested subject, person, place, event or object. It must be a photograph, painting, drawing or museum artefact. Reject logos, emblems, flags, maps, charts, pages of text, screenshots, statues or modern photos when a historical scene was requested, and anything that only shares a keyword. Reply with JSON only: {"match": true or false, "reason": "one short sentence"}.
